scenarios.title: Initial legal play for every supported count
scenarios.expectation: For each count 2–10, every player has at least one legal semantic face-down card commitment at the start of a round.

source.quote: Spieler: 2–10 Personen; Alle Spieler legen verdeckt eine Karte

scenarios.title: Bounded game playability for every supported count
scenarios.expectation: For each count 2–10, a deterministic legal-policy rollout reaches the end of one ten-round game within a fixed bound without crashing.

source.quote: Spieler: 2–10 Personen; bis nach zehn Runden alle Karten ausgespielt wurden

supporting_sources.quote: Das Spiel endet, wenn alle Handkarten ausgespielt wurden.

scenarios.title: Reject unsupported player counts
scenarios.expectation: Constructor raises ValueError for 0, 1, 11 and a larger count.

source.quote: Spieler: 2–10 Personen

scenarios.title: Exact augmented card inventory
scenarios.expectation: Across hands, rows and reserve, every value 1–104 appears exactly once and bullhead metadata matches the observation.

source.quote: Inhalt: 104 Spielkarten

scenarios.title: Hidden commits and joint reveal
scenarios.expectation: Earlier commits remain identity-hidden from opponents; all identities become jointly visible only after the last commit.

source.quote: Alle Spieler legen verdeckt ... wenn der Letzte sich entschieden hat, werden die Karten aufgedeckt.

scenarios.title: Irrevocable seat-ordered commits
scenarios.expectation: Seats commit in ascending order, cannot undo, and current_player advances only among uncommitted seats.

source.quote: Alle Spieler legen verdeckt eine Karte

scenarios.title: Ascending resolution order
scenarios.expectation: A revealed set resolves lowest to highest regardless of seat order.

source.quote: Wer die niedrigste Karte ausgespielt hat, legt sie als Erster

scenarios.title: Mandatory minimum difference
scenarios.expectation: The printed example resolves to rows 12-14-15, 37, 43-44, and 58-61.

scenarios.title: Sixth card captures five
scenarios.expectation: A forced sixth card captures exactly the prior five and remains as the sole starter; it is not itself captured.

source.quote: sechste Karte ... alle fünf Karten ... neue Reihe

scenarios.title: Low card permits any row
scenarios.expectation: All four row choices are legal; the chosen row is captured regardless of length and replaced by the low card.

source.quote: alle Karten einer beliebigen Reihe nehmen

scenarios.title: Ordered resolution pauses for low choice
scenarios.expectation: Automatic resolution pauses for the low card owner, exposes exactly four row choices, then resumes the next higher card.

source.quote: einer beliebigen Reihe

scenarios.title: Dynamic low-card recomputation
scenarios.expectation: After 3 replaces a row, 9 is placed against updated rows and follows 3.

source.quote: Mit seiner ‚3‘ ... Der Spieler mit der Karte ‚9‘ ... hinter die ‚3‘

scenarios.title: Dynamic later sixth-card cascade
scenarios.expectation: After 29 changes a row, 62 recomputes its destination and captures the now-forced five-card row.

source.quote: 29 ... leert die erste Reihe ... 62 ... vierte Reihe ... alle fünf Karten

scenarios.title: Captured cards leave play
scenarios.expectation: Captured cards enter only the capture pile, increase its subtotal, never return to hand and cannot be committed.

source.quote: Hornochsenstapel ... dürfen nicht auf die Hand genommen werden

scenarios.title: Publisher scoring categories
scenarios.expectation: Given representative stated category values, captured multiples of five, multiples of ten, repeated digits and 55 score exactly 2, 3, 5 and 7 bullheads; each bullhead is one penalty point.

source.quote: Fünferzahlen ... 2; Zehnerzahlen ... 3; Paschzahlen ... 5; 55 ... 7

scenarios.title: Complete observed bullhead inventory
scenarios.expectation: All 104 observed card identities have the approved complete bullhead mapping, including one bullhead for every remaining ordinary value.

source.quote: {"55":7,"other_repeated_digit_values":5,"other_multiples_of_10":3,"other_multiples_of_5":2,"all_remaining_values":1}

scenarios.title: Exactly ten rounds per game
scenarios.expectation: After nine rounds hands have one card and game continues; after round ten hands empty, captures score, and no further commit occurs in that game.

source.quote: nach zehn Runden alle Karten ausgespielt

supporting_sources.quote: Jetzt nimmt jeder seinen Hornochsenstapel und zählt seine Minuspunkte.

scenarios.title: New game begins below threshold
scenarios.expectation: Below threshold, the match remains nonterminal and a newly shuffled ten-card/four-row game starts while cumulative scores remain.

source.quote: Und sofort beginnt ein neues Spiel.

supporting_sources.quote: Mischen Sie alle Karten und teilen Sie an jeden Spieler 10 Karten aus.
die obersten vier Karten offen untereinander
Die Ergebnisse von jedem Spieler werden auf einem Blatt Papier notiert.

scenarios.title: Strictly greater than 66 after game
scenarios.expectation: Exactly 66 continues; 67 ends, but only after the current game fully scores.

source.quote: bis ein Spieler insgesamt über 66

scenarios.title: Lowest cumulative score wins
scenarios.expectation: When the threshold is crossed, the unique lowest cumulative score is winner even if another player crossed 66.

source.quote: Sieger wird der Spieler, der die wenigsten Hornochsen besitzt.

scenarios.title: Tied minimum creates co-winners
scenarios.expectation: All players tied at the minimum are winners.

source.quote: die wenigsten Hornochsen

scenarios.title: Seeded shuffle and full-deck reset
scenarios.expectation: Equal seed reproduces setup and successive games; different seed can differ; every new game accounts for all 104 cards with no stale captured cards.

source.quote: Mischen Sie alle Karten

scenarios.title: Player-specific private observations
scenarios.expectation: Own hand/capture identities visible; opponent hand identities, pending commitments and captured identities hidden; opponent counts and bull subtotal visible.

source.quote: Alle Spieler legen verdeckt eine Karte von ihren Handkarten vor sich auf den Tisch.

supporting_sources.quote: Karten, die Sie kassieren mussten, legen Sie verdeckt vor sich auf den Tisch.

scenarios.title: Terminal returns
scenarios.expectation: Nonterminal returns are all zero; every co-winner gets +1 and every loser -1.

source.quote: Sieger wird der Spieler
